changelog:
- Major documentation restructuring for clarity and accuracy.
- API flow updated: only the video requires separate upload via /upload-video; face image uploads directly in the /faceswap/create-job request.
- Added precise example commands for each API step and clarified which headers and formats are required.
- Reinforced that all multipart/form-data operations must use curl -F, not JSON.
- Maximum video duration for job is now clearly set to 30 seconds; videos must be trimmed beforehand if longer.
- Removed redundant and outdated files; now references only skill.md.
- Added quick troubleshooting for yt-dlp dependencies and outlined temp file handling.
summary: AI Face Swap - Swap face in video using verging.ai API. Supports local video files, YouTube/Bilibili URLs, local and remote face images. Auto-download, trimm...
